headline: Vidhigya Associates acts on Nityas Gems & Jewellery ₹108 crore IPO
sum: Nityas Gems & Jewellery Limited has launched its initial public offering totaling ₹108.35 crore comprising entirely of a fresh issue of 1.45 crore Equity Shares. Vidhigya Associates acted as the sole legal counsel for the Issue.
detail: Nityas Gems & Jewellery Limited has launched its initial public offering totaling ₹108.35 crore comprising entirely of a fresh issue of 1.45 crore Equity Shares. Vidhigya Associates acted as the sole legal counsel for the Issue. The transaction team comprised Rahul Pandey (Managing Partner) and Vedang Mehta (Associate Partner). Nityas Nityas Gems & Jewellery is engaged in the design, manufacturing and sale of lab-grown diamond studded gold jewellery in India, operating through an integrated business model comprising B2B manufacturing and distribution to organised retailers, standalone retailers and wholesalers, and D2C omnichannel retail operations through its subsidiary, Ayaani Diamonds…
